title: Allow TodoWrite tool for PreToolUse hook
body: I was trying to create a hook that would trigger on TodoWrite tool calls to verify that the Todo List are correct and not incorrectly changed, however looking at docs and from my testing it doesn't seem like TodoWrite is available in the hook.
author: Vistyy

top_comments.author: coygeek
top_comments.body:
Hey, that's a great question. I took a look through the docs and did some digging myself, and I think you're right.

Looking at the [Hooks reference documentation](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/hooks#pretooluse), the list of common matchers for `PreToolUse` and `PostToolUse` includes things like `Bash`, `Read`, `Write`, `WebFetch`, etc., but `TodoWrite` isn't on that list.

My guess, just as another user, is that `TodoWrite` might be considered a more internal, state-management

top_comments.author: TikkanadityaSiddartha
coygeek
